title: Reasoning Isn’t Enough: Examining Truth-Bias and Sycophancy in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on a balanced dataset of truthful and deceptive hotel reviews to calculate the proportion of statements judged as truthful out of the total evaluated, regardless of their actual veracity.

Analyzing the asymmetry in detection accuracy by comparing high truth accuracy against low deception accuracy, identifying the models' tendencies to excessively affirm perceived truths rather than critically evaluate them.
